## What counts as evidence?

A passed mission check means particular assertions passed. In mission 2, the checks compare inclusive boundaries, retained rows, raw input preservation, and the full condition summary against the reference. They do not prove that every possible input is handled or that the exclusion policy is scientifically justified. Explain why the check matters, then test an input of your own.

A restart clears Python variables and virtual filesystem changes. The editors are reapplied to the new virtual project. **Run All** uses the existing kernel; **Restart & Run All** creates a new one. Mission 4 always performs a fresh run before checking. For a real handoff, also recreate the local environment and inputs.

## Take it into your own project

[Download the complete project](downloads/motion-perception.zip), install it using [setup](setup.qmd), and run the saved Stage A/B/C notebooks in Jupyter. Exported lab notebooks expect the **project root** as their working directory; put your exported `helpers.py` there and `analysis.toml` inside `config/`. In Jupyter launched elsewhere, resolve the project path explicitly as the complete notebooks demonstrate.

The browser has Python 3.12.7, NumPy 2.0.2, pandas 2.2.3, and Matplotlib 3.8.4. The downloaded project has its own tested dependency lock; record which environment produced a result. This lab supports ordinary Python cells and the bundled scientific packages. It does not implement Jupyter magics, widgets, interactive input, a terminal, arbitrary package installation, or access to your computer's files. A cell has a 15-second execution limit; Stop clears the worker if needed.

Continue with [the notebook lesson](modules/02-notebooks.qmd), [the code explorer](modules/03-refactoring.qmd), or [your personal handoff plan](practice.qmd).
